0022600114.text: The New York Knicks, 0-2 and 12th in the East, host the Orlando Magic, also 0-2 and 14th in the East, in the Knicks' third game of the 2026-27 season, with both teams on two-game losing streaks. The teams have not met yet this season, and they split their four 2025-26 meetings 2-2, with the Knicks' most recent win coming 132-120 in Orlando on December 13, 2025. Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (out, ankle surgery) and Noah Penda (out, hamstring strain), while Anthony Black (ankle sprain), Jonathan Isaac (knee) and Paolo Banchero (ankle soreness) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions.
